sample.The Real Challenge: Resilience efforts are fragmented, and underinvestment is leaving vulnerable communities unprotected.
sample.The Path Forward: Create a National Resilience Retrofit Fund targeting upgrades to homes, roads, and utilities in high-risk areas.
sample.Your Role: Support or join local climate resilience projects, share data about local vulnerabilities, and encourage officials to prioritize adaptation.
